name: Dark Ages 4 (story)
notes: Gravestones declared at level start on 5-1, 6-2, 6-4, 7-1, 8-2, 8-5, 9-4 hold no plant while they stand; give ground for that activation once one has been destroyed. Entering the level shuffles gravestone bags of 3, 3 and 4 objects with the shared engine, in that order, before anything is planted.
